legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains what information Wizzo Market collects, why we collect it, and the choices you have. It applies to the Wizzo Market app and website.
legal.privacySection1Body1: When you create an account you provide your name, email address, and phone number. When you place orders we keep a record of your addresses and purchases.
legal.privacySection1Body2: We collect in-app data such as your wishlist, chat messages, reviews, and notification preferences so features work as expected.
legal.privacySection2Body1: Your information is used to run your account, deliver orders, process payments, protect the marketplace, and keep you informed about your activity.
legal.privacySection2Body2: With your permission we send promotional updates and offers. You can turn these off anytime from Notification Settings in your account.
legal.privacySection3Body1: Sellers see the details needed to fulfil your order, such as delivery address and phone number. Payment details stay with your mobile money or bank provider.
legal.privacySection3Body2: We never sell your personal information to third parties.
legal.privacySection4Body1: You can update your profile and delivery addresses, change your email or password, and control notifications from the account menu.
legal.privacySection4Body2: You can request deletion of your account and data by emailing {email}. We normally action these requests within 30 days.
legal.privacySection5Body1: Passwords are stored hashed and communications are protected in transit. Access to accounts requires your credentials.
legal.privacySection5Body2: We keep records while your account is active and as long as required by law or for resolving disputes.
legal.termsIntro: Welcome to Wizzo Market. These Terms of Service govern your use of the Wizzo Market app and website. Please read them carefully before using the platform.
legal.termsSection1Body1: Wizzo Market connects buyers and sellers in Africa. By using the app you agree to act honestly, only list items you genuinely have, and never mislead or defraud another user.
legal.termsSection1Body2: You must be at least 18 years old to create an account, or have a parent or guardian agree to these terms on your behalf.
legal.termsSection2Body1: When you place an order you commit to paying for it using a supported method: mobile money, bank transfer, card, or cash on delivery where available.
legal.termsSection2Body2: Mobile Money transactions are processed by your provider and are subject to their transaction fees, limits, and terms. Never send money before you are happy with your order.
legal.termsSection2Body3: Delivery times depend on the seller and location. You can track order progress from the My Orders screen and contact the seller in-app through chat.
legal.termsSection3Body1: If an order arrives damaged, incorrect, or not as described, request a return from the order screen within 7 days of delivery.
legal.termsSection3Body2: Refunds are issued to the same payment method you used, once the seller confirms the return. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to your Wizzo Wallet.
legal.termsSection4Body1: You are responsible for keeping your login details safe. Report any suspicious activity to {email}.
legal.termsSection4Body2: Wizzo may suspend accounts that break these terms, attempt to defraud other users, or use the platform for prohibited activity.
legal.termsSection5Body1: Wizzo is a marketplace platform that facilitates transactions between buyers and sellers. We are not a party to each sale and we are not liable for a seller's products or services beyond what these terms describe.
legal.termsSection5Body2: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Wizzo's total liability is limited to the amount you actually paid on the transaction in question.
